skillFull: Unleashes a Scallion Blade Blast that creates Scallion Kimchi Bear Jellies at certain intervals. The Blast destroys obstacles that create additional Scallion Kimchi Bear Jellies. After unleashing a certain number of blasts, the Cookie is wrapped in a Scallion Kimchi Energy as she blasts forward, using her blades to destroy even more obstacles to create more Jellies. Level Up for more points for Scallion Kimchi Bear Jellies.
story:
There once was a young scallion that grew rapidly, eyes set on the distant sky. Once fresh and green, hopeful for the day it would finally meet the One it would serve, upon completing its spiritual trials at the behest of the Heavens it found itself fully ripened into a certain Scallion Kimchi Cookie. There's no telling quite how concentrated the ingredients—the strongest of garlics, chili powders, and even anchovy fish sauce—used to ferment this Cookie were. The only thing certain is that following her trials, she acquired a tremendous spiritual power.

You might think her usual exhausted, haggard appearance could chase off evil spirits on its own, but the true unbearable spice begins the moment she takes up her twin sacred blades. The blades, drenched in kimchi brine, dance through the air and cut down any and all malicious spirits. Her uncharacteristically glinting, aware eyes are sharp enough one might think even the One she serves would avert Her gaze.

As the ritual comes to a close, Scallion Kimchi Cookie returns to her same, listless self, almost as if nothing happened, collapsing the moment she steps foot into the shrine. Just how much energy is she pouring into her exorcism rituals?!

costumes.info: Behold the shaman, channeling the energies of the Great Fish Sauce General, Salt General, and Chili Pepper General! So infamous are here exorcisms that the malicious spirits go running as soon as word gets around she's preparing for another ritual. Her blades are as merciless as the kimchi brine that drips off their edges, and the evil intentions may want to change their minds!
